tools.name: traecn_send_message
tools.description: Submit one user instruction to TraeCN as durable background work and return its stable taskId immediately; the gateway owns queueing, retries, recovery, and result persistence. Use this for every delegated coding request, optionally targeting an existing conversation via conversationId. Do not send follow-up messages to probe progress — track the returned task instead.

tools.name: traecn_get_task
tools.description: Read one known gateway task by ID: status plus final result, or the full execution trace with detailLevel 'trace' for diagnosis. Call once when notified of completion or once later when resuming after a disconnect. Not a progress primitive — do not poll in a tight loop.

taskId.description: Stable task identifier returned by traecn_send_message.

detailLevel.description: result returns only the final answer (default); trace includes the full visible Trae execution process.

tools.name: traecn_cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel one gateway-tracked task by ID. The gateway stops shepherding the work at its next control point and records the cancellation; results already produced remain in task history. Returns the task identity and post-cancellation status.

taskId.description: Stable task identifier returned by traecn_send_message.

tools.name: traecn_stop_generation
tools.description: Stop only the generation currently visible in the named active TraeCN conversation. Visible output may belong to the user or another agent, so this requires acknowledgeUntrackedWork=true plus an audit reason. Prefer cancel_task whenever a gateway task ID exists.

acknowledgeUntrackedWork.description: Must be true to acknowledge that visible work may belong to the user or another agent.

reason.description: Concise reason recorded in the local security audit log.

tools.name: traecn_open_workspace
tools.description: Open one absolute local folder path as the active TraeCN workspace and verify it became active before returning. Call before submitting work that depends on a specific project; afterwards do not repeat the path inside the task message.

tools.name: traecn_list_models
tools.description: List the model names currently offered in the TraeCN UI together with the currently selected model. Read-only discovery; call before select_model whenever the model choice matters.

tools.name: traecn_select_model
tools.description: Select one model by exact name from traecn_list_models and confirm the picker state before returning. Selecting the already-active model succeeds as a no-op. Does not wait for model availability or capacity.

model.description: Exact model name as returned by traecn_list_models.

tools.name: traecn_select_mode
tools.description: Switch TraeCN between Solo and IDE mode and confirm the resulting active mode. Switching to the current mode succeeds as a no-op. Call only when the requested mode differs.

tools.name: traecn_list_setting_sections
tools.description: List the settings sections currently visible in TraeCN's settings UI. Required first step for any settings operation; never guess a section name.

tools.name: traecn_list_settings
tools.description: List the individual settings and their control types within one section returned by traecn_list_setting_sections. Read-only discovery preceding any setting mutation; never guess a label.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

tools.name: traecn_list_setting_options
tools.description: List the visible choices of one dropdown-style setting identified by section and label. Required before select_setting_option; never invent an option value.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

tools.name: traecn_set_setting_toggle
tools.description: Enable or disable one toggle setting identified by section and label, then read back the applied state. Applying the already-current state succeeds as a no-op.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

tools.name: traecn_select_setting_option
tools.description: Select one previously listed option for a dropdown setting identified by section and label, and confirm the applied selection. Only values returned by traecn_list_setting_options are valid.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

value.description: Option value exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_options.

tools.name: traecn_set_setting_text
tools.description: Enter one text value into the setting field identified by section and label, and confirm what the field contains afterwards.

section.description: Section name exactly as returned by traecn_list_setting_sections.

label.description: Setting label exactly as returned by traecn_list_settings.

text.description: Text content to enter into the field.

tools.name: traecn_list_conversations
tools.description: List the conversations available in the current TraeCN mode with stable identifiers accepted by conversation-scoped tools. Read-only; call when choosing or verifying conversation context.

tools.name: traecn_create_conversation
tools.description: Create a new TraeCN conversation and make it the active target. Every call creates an additional conversation, so call at most once per genuinely new context. Returns the created conversation identity.

tools.name: traecn_select_conversation
tools.description: Make one existing conversation the active target for subsequent visible interaction. Returns the confirmed active conversation identity.

tools.name: traecn_delete_conversation
tools.description: Permanently delete one inactive TraeCN conversation by stable identifier. Requires the exact expectedTitle returned by traecn_list_conversations plus an explicit irreversible-deletion acknowledgement; there is no gateway recovery path.

acknowledgePermanentDeletion.description: Must be true to acknowledge that the gateway cannot restore the deleted conversation.

tools.name: traecn_answer_question
tools.description: Resolve an exceptional question from TraeCN that the gateway could not handle mechanically by supplying the user's decision. The gateway routes the answer to the pending visible prompt and reports the outcome. Only call when a pending interaction exists.

answer.description: The user's answer to the pending question.

tools.name: traecn_decide_approval
tools.description: Approve or deny the unsafe or ambiguous command card currently visible in TraeCN. Approval revalidates the exact expectedCommand against the card and requires acknowledgeRisk plus an audit reason recorded locally; denial needs only the decision. Never approve beyond the scope the user authorized.

expectedCommand.description: For approve, the exact command returned with the pending interaction.

acknowledgeRisk.description: For approve, must be true after checking the command against the user-authorized scope.

reason.description: For approve, a concise authorization reason recorded in the local security audit log.
